name: Exage 400LX normal-band front derailleur (1990 reference)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 132 g for FD-M400 in its explicitly identified 28.0–28.6 mm normal-band configuration. The EC-type and later -B references remain separate; another clamp size or suffix equivalence is not inferred.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1990 dealer product manual, PDF page 56 / printed 53: Exage 400LX: RD-M400-GS explicitly 318 g; FD-M400 132 g normal band with sole 28.0–28.6 mm band; BB-M500 and shared 500LX cassette inventory
